title: Alec Pierce, Charvarius Ward Sr. return to practice; Colts roster cuts loom
channel_name: The James Boyd Podcast
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and Jim Ayello react to Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce's first practice since undergoing left ankle and heel surgery. Cornerback Charvarius Ward Sr. also returned from a back injury, though his outlook is concerning. Boyd and Ayello then took a look at key position battles ahead of Sunday's roster cuts. They rounded out this episode by congratulating punter Rigoberto Sanchez on his new deal. Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company. text: The Broncos must trim the roster to 53 players this weekend, and with one preseason game left — Friday night against the Vikings — it’s officially bubble‑watch season in Denver.
